system.description:
Karuum (sometimes called Ironcap) develop dense fibrous tissue and overlapping plates across the shoulders, chest and limbs. Their caps are commonly thick, ridged and comparatively compact, giving them a heavy, durable appearance.
They traditionally work in construction, excavation and defence, particularly within the deepest portions of a settlement where collapse or hostile underground creatures pose constant threats. Karuum culture values reliability more than aggression. An Ironcap who promises to hold a tunnel, carry a burden or protect a chamber is expected to remain there long after more flamboyant companions have discovered somewhere else to be heroic.
Your hardened body grants you Base DR 1.
